उष्ट्रः [उष्-ट्रन्-किच्च Uṇ. 4. 161]
1 A camel; अथोष्ट्रवामीशतवाहितार्थं
R. 5. 32; Ms. 3. 162, 4. 120, 11. 202.
--2 A buffalo.
--3 A bull with
a hump.
--4 A cart or carriage.
--ष्ट्री
1 A she-camel.
--2 An earthen
vessel in the shape of a camel. [cf.
Pers. ushtar; Zend ustra.]
--Comp.
--कर्णिका (pl.) N. of a country or
its inhabitants, in the south.
--कांडी
a flower of a red colour.
--क्रोशिन्
a. making a noise like a camel.
--गोयुगं a couple of camels
--ग्रीवः,
--शिरोधरः piles.
--यानं camel-litter.

1 A she-camel.
--2 An
earthen wine-vessel of the shape of
